text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At lunchtime, I spotted Rhein Kraft
smiling in front of a large box.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Mhfufu~.
Which one should I pick neeeext~♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
Take a look at this!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
A souvenir from Dad—
a whole box full of chocolates!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu~~. Isn't it wonderful~!
This box is packed fu~ll of happiness♪

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Dad goes on a lot of overseas business trips,
so he's always sending home tons of souvenirs.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
This chocolate is something I had back in Australia
when I was little and said tasted delicious.

text_block_list.name: Young Craft
text_block_list.text:
Waah~~, so yummy~~!
Daddy, this chocolate is so yummy~!

text_block_list.name: Young Craft
text_block_list.text:
*Munch, munch*... *gulp*!
......All the chocolate's gone.

text_block_list.name: Young Craft
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah! More chocolate!
I wanna eat way more~~!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Sending this much over.
Fufufu, I suppose you remember what happened back then."

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna enjoy every single bite of this chocolate filled with all my dad's love!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"I know they're waiting for my review.
So I'm gonna finish every last bite today!"
choice_data_list: Let's finish it all and tell your dad!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her that her father would be sad
if she made herself sick by overeating.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
T-True!
Now that you mention it...

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Getting feedback all at once is great, but getting a little bit every day might be nice too.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Then I'll just eat a little bit and tell my father what I thought of it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rhein Kraft decided to eat just a moderate amount of chocolate.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~n♪
Let's get right to it then~.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~~, so good~~♪
I could eat this forever~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Rhein Kraft took out the massive pile of chocolate from the box and ate every last piece.
